summary: This joint resolution disapproves a rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency concerning the phasedown and management of hydrofluorocarbons, which would prevent the rule from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill disapproves an EPA rule that phases down hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), which are potent greenhouse gases. By nullifying this rule, the bill would prevent a measure aimed at reducing environmental harm, thus leading to less environmental protection.
